title: broker order-id write path

shape_chosen.decision: BOTH a Fill field and a placement receipt
shape_chosen.why_not_field_alone: a field on the returned Fill only exists if the call returns; the entry fill poll blocks up to 30s and that window is where a crash loses the id
shape_chosen.why_not_receipt_alone: the outcome row still has to carry the id for the reconcile

send_order.not_carrying: 1 - test mode, which places nothing and invents nothing
send_order.receipt_fires: after placeOrder, before the fill poll
send_order.why: the broad handler turns an exception into Fill(status=CANCELLED); reporting a LIVE order as cancelled is the worst available answer

journal.amendment: SUBMITTED -> SUBMITTED, permitted ONLY as the arrival of the broker id
rules: previous row must have no id
an id may never be replaced
journal.shared_rule: track1_order_state.is_amendment, used by resolve_journal and asserted by the writer

bug_found_and_fixed_in_stage.what: append accepted the amendment; resolve called the resulting journal an impossible history
bug_found_and_fixed_in_stage.effect: every order that got an id would have made that day's journal unreadable
bug_found_and_fixed_in_stage.why_tests_missed_it: all 52 checked the write; none re-read
bug_found_and_fixed_in_stage.found_by: running the round trip by hand, not by a test
bug_found_and_fixed_in_stage.fix: one shared rule (is_amendment) used by writer and reader; 6 read-back tests added

read_side.fallback_when_no_id: working orders matched on instrument AND action, then positions

families: id fabricated or answering for the wrong order
mutations.unfaithful_reason: source patches against behaviour tests (Stage 5V M3 lesson repeated), and one patch of a module attribute the test had already imported by name
found_a_real_test_hole: M17 - an unparseable file was skipped rather than reported
